snippet.title: AFAR: An Interactive Horror Film - Trailer
snippet.description:
Now available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4064520/AFAR_An_Interactive_Horror_Film/?beta=1

...and Region Free DVD: https://kunaki.com/sales.asp?PID=PX00ZF048L&pp=1

......AND BOOK: https://www.amazon.com/AFAR-Choose-You-Own-Horror/dp/B0FTGBW37B?ref_=ast_author_dp

When contestants on a survival reality show vanish without a trace in the haunted expanse of Barlang Valley, one paranormal investigator's search for the truth unravels a web of urban legends, supernatural forces, and a dark history that refuses to stay buried. 

You will make decisions, unlock unique scenes and endings, all with your DVD remote. can you survive the horror and unravel the entire mystery? Multiple choices, multiple endings and multiple deaths await... now prepare to choose or prepare to die.
